method.method_draft: Read the grid positions from the image as a 4 by 4 array: r1c1=1, r1c3=x, r2c1=4, r2c2=1, r3c2=3, r4c2=2. From the text, every row and column must contain each of 1,2,3,4 exactly once. Use column 2 first: it already has 1,3,2, so r1c2 must be 4. Then row 1 contains 1 and 4, so the only possible values for x=r1c3 are 2 or 3. Finally, verify both candidates can be extended to a full Latin-square completion by writing one valid completion for x=2 and one valid completion for x=3. Since both work and 1,4 are impossible, the count is 2.

method.method_draft: Read the same initial grid from the image. Use the text condition to view each row as a permutation of 1,2,3,4. Column 2 has entries blank,1,3,2, so the missing symbol in its top cell is 4; hence the first row must be a permutation beginning 1,4,_,_. There are only two possible first rows: 1,4,2,3 or 1,4,3,2, so x is respectively 2 or 3. To confirm that neither first-row choice is ruled out by the remaining givens, complete the remaining rows as permutations satisfying the column constraints, or equivalently build a Latin completion for each of the two first rows. Thus the possible x-values are exactly the two symbols 2 and 3.

推理：每一行和每一列都必须恰好包含 1,2,3,4。观察第二列，它从上到下是空格、1、3、2，所以第二列缺少的数字是 4，因此第一行第二列必须是 4。于是第一行已经有 1 和 4，形式为 1,4,x,空格。第一行还缺少 2 和 3，所以 x 只能是 2 或 3。
